question: Should this PR preserve the existing stable recorderPath and recover ownership-mismatched artifact directories, or intentionally make both behaviors fail/change on upgrade?
rationale: The patch can be mechanically hardened, but choosing whether existing recorder consumers and directories must remain compatible is a maintainer-owned upgrade-contract decision.

options.title: Preserve upgrade compatibility
options.body: Keep recorderPath stable, add a separately versioned snapshot path, and safely migrate or quarantine ownership-mismatched artifact directories before publication.

options.title: Adopt strict new contracts
options.body: Accept the new recorderPath and ownership behavior only with explicit schema/version signaling, operator migration guidance, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause the combined change
options.body: Split immutable snapshot publication from strict ownership enforcement so each compatibility decision can be reviewed and proven independently.

recommendation.title: Preserve upgrade compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep recorderPath stable, add a separately versioned snapshot path, and safely migrate or quarantine ownership-mismatched artifact directories before publication.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the clearest available context for the intended artifact contract and persistence implementation.
